scope: Prospective count outcomes only; exact frozen and finished cards keep their original source scale
birth_denominator: Women in the exact declared maternal-age population, never total resident population

local_denominator_contract.population_filters: Exact equality with the card; birth sex=female; mortality/events match declared sex (female, male, all)
local_denominator_contract.suppression: Numerator suppression remains missing even when a population or published rate exists

wonder_population: Use Population from the receipt-bound exact state/year/cause/age export; preserve Crude Rate reliability flags
wonder_birth_population: Use Female Population from the receipt-bound exact state/year/maternal-age export; 1999-2002 and under15/50+ unavailable
unavailable_denominator_disposition: Park; no fallback to count, no inferred population or changed age group, no outcome association or model dispatch
